Name: Cuter Fatter Buns
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
At this time there is no difference between the baby and adult buns with this mod because I honestly suck at downsizing/adjusting the art to be smaller. If anyone wants to make baby buns for these please feel free and if you would let me include it in this mod I would be very grateful and will be sure to credit you for your contribution! 

To Install:
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your baby rabbit.xnb and rabbit.xnb files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
[color=#f1f1f1]4. Done! Launch the game and enjoy your ch0nks![/color]
